Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Indian craftsman · Coomaraswamy, Ananda Kentish, 1877-1947 · 1909, 160 scanned pages. Published 1909; Ananda K. Coomaraswamy died 1947; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit.
